caption: The drawing features two views of an ornate brass object, identified as a candle snuffer, rendered in colored pencil or pastel with line and shading for detail. The main composition is dominated by a top view of the candle snuffer, which has a gold-toned, metallic appearance with elaborate, swirling handles and a cylindrical central chamber, attached to a scissor-like pivot. The handles are intricately designed, ending in looped spirals. Below the handles, at one end, is a small disc-shaped foot. The side view is sketched in a lighter grey color above the main drawing and shows the profile of the object, including the domed chamber and flat, base elements with a knob visible at its apex. The background is a light beige color, and the drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular outline. Text below the drawing reads: "FULL SIZE CANDLE SNUFFER BRASS 1820" and "MOTAM" in small, capitalized letters.
title: Snuffer
